scope: standard-library controls and read-only metadata; not scientific runtime registration
accounting: min(physical MemAvailable, every finite visible memory.max/high minus memory.current); no page-cache credit
root_without_memory_controller_files: root recorded explicitly; physical MemAvailable and full-boot journal retained; missing nonroot or partial root files rejected
kernel: full current-boot JSON kernel journal, unique cursors, boot/monotonic validation, immutable historical prefix SHA; any FATAL/OOM rejected, no historical exceptions
